synopsis: Koki is a big, burly high school student who fits in well with the boys. But deep down, he's confused by the topics of conversation and can't honestly talk about his knowledge of plants. title: Hoshikuzu Nina
synopsis: By being dumped into garbage dump, the past record of the robot- Debris Kun (memory) has disappeared stardust (stardust). Duo encounter, the pretty high school girl Nina picked up him is not the master robot, the teacher and to be grown stardust. They lived together. This world wonder is full! Snakehead falls from the space, of monkey that conversation toy, ¥ 300 million of lottery hit, and Sugiyuku time. "After one year, five years later, 10 years later..." every time you go through one volume, and "50 years later", time in the work is progressesive very quickly. Robot does not take the old, but human beings go quickly old. The girl grown into adult women, the surrounding environment is also changed to a more SF view of the world. Human beings are dying, but the stardust of the robot does not die. This manga, for the reader, have received the feeling of being watched the transience of the world from likely God's point of view. The story, in God's speed, proceed to the future. "Boys and Girls", followed by "Mobile Brigade eight Fukujin", the new "time skip comedy" series of Satoshi Fukushima, it is "Stardust Nina"!

synopsis: Alban realizes that he had been reincarnated as the “villainous nobleman” of a fantasy novel. Just as he starts rigorously training in sword and sorcery so that he would not be defeated by the hero, Alban finds out that Leticia, the daughter of the villain, is to be his bride! Leticia is a young lady who is the subject of many unsavory rumors! He was scared to see what kind of “bad girl” she would be… But when he meets her, she seems pure and beautiful as an angel, almost like his ideal woman. Alban is so smitten that he forgets all about his plan to avoid the bad ending. He decides to strike back at the mastermind behind his beloved wife's downfall! Using their own villainous reputation to their advantage, he sets a trap to lure out the culprit......? (Source: Corona EX, translated)

synopsis: On days when Sunao is sick, or not feeling like going to school, she is called to take her place. She was born to this world when Sunao wished to have a substitute. No one knows that she exists, but she tries to do her best for Sunao whenever she is called. One day she talks with Sanada, one of her classmates. They become friends, but soon he notices that she is different from the original Sunao...he was the first one who did. She tells him to talk with her only when she has her hair half-up. Sanada does like she told him, and they enjoy their time together. As they become closer, she realizes that she has special feelings toward Sanada. But she doesn't know what will happen to her...if she, a replica, falls in love. (Source: BookWalker)

synopsis: Maki Maehara is always on his own at school. He has no friends or hobbies others share, and he doesn't expect the upcoming academic year to be any different, even surrounded by new faces. And six months later, it seems like he was right-until he runs into his popular classmate Umi Asanagi at a video store! Always at the center of attention and called the "second prettiest in class" by the boys, Asanagi's from a totally different world. But it turns out the two have more overlapping interests than just the B-grade movies they came to check out...and Asanagi asks Maehara to be her friend! (Source: Yen Press)
